These files were generated by us. The `.emf` files are recorded with Windows GDI calls (`CreateEnhMetaFile`) and GDI+ from synthetic
drawings (the `g_*_dual` files carry GDI+ records and the GDI records that stand in for them). Each `_gdi_256x256.png` is what
Windows GDI `PlayEnhMetaFile` drew for the file into a white 32-bit bitmap of 256 x 256 pixels, the whole picture frame stretched
over it (Windows 11, 150% display scaling, ClearType on). They contain no third-party content.
The rendering tests compare the vector output with these images.
